BorrowBrella pursues two measurable objectives. First, it expands shared-umbrella
coverage until every major transit stop in the pilot city has a self-service
lending stand, so that a caught-out commuter is always within a short walk of a
borrowable umbrella. Second, it raises the return rate above ninety percent
through a light-touch deposit-and-reminder scheme, keeping enough stock in
circulation for the network to remain useful across a rainy week. Together the
objectives define a network that is both widely reachable and self-sustaining.
